  • Constructor Details

    • StructureEventToggleEnd

      public StructureEventToggleEnd(Structure structure, StructureSnapshot snapshot, StructureActionCause cause, StructureActionType actionType, IPlayer responsible, double time, boolean skipAnimation)
      Constructs a structure action event.
      Parameters:
      structure - The structure.
      cause - What caused the action.
      actionType - The type of action.
      responsible - Who is responsible for this structure. This player may be online, but does not have to be.
      time - The number of seconds the structure will take to open. Note that there are other factors that affect the total time as well.
      skipAnimation - If true, the structure will skip the animation and open instantly.

    • getSnapshot

      public StructureSnapshot getSnapshot()
      Description copied from interface: IStructureToggleEvent
      Before the structure is animated, a snapshot of the data is created which is then used for all calculations.

      The snapshots are read-only, so this snapshot contains the old data of the structure before the animation was applied.

      Specified by:
      getSnapshot in interface IStructureToggleEvent
      Returns:
      A snapshot of the structure created at the time the toggle action was requested.

    • getResponsible

      public IPlayer getResponsible()
      Description copied from interface: IStructureToggleEvent
      Gets the UUID of the player responsible for this structure action. This either means the player who directly requested this action or, if it was requested indirectly (e.g. via redstone), the prime owner of the structure. Therefore, this player might not be online.
      Specified by:
      getResponsible in interface IStructureToggleEvent
      Returns:
      The player that is responsible for this event.
